parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Config stem in config/ (without .json), or askuser for the picker. May also be a comma-separated list of stems; when multiple, taskPick chooses one (same rules as tasks).

parameters.name: tasks
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated pool of config stems (e.g. nafc_study1_A,nafc_study1_B,nafc_study1_C). When non-empty, overrides task for config selection (askuser still works if task=askuser and tasks is empty). Empty = use task alone.

parameters.name: taskPick
parameters.description: How to choose among multiple stems in tasks or a comma-separated task list. random = uniform draw; first = always first stem; subnum = gSubNum mod N (1-based index). Ignored when only one stem.

parameters.name: useWaterfallAnimation
parameters.description: Scroll waterfall during the response wait (0/1). Not wired yet.

parameters.name: responsemode
parameters.description: How to answer RT trials (Simon, go/no-go). auto = shift keys native, Z/slash in browser. mousebutton = left/right click anywhere. mousetarget = click on-screen targets. Identification trials still click vessel thumbnails.
